title: Color picker: With alpha
description: A translucent overlay color with an opacity slider, written out as rgba and 8-digit hex.

{label} {value}
) } export default function ColorPickerAlphaExample() { const [overlay, setOverlay] = React.useState("#0f172a8c") const details = getColorDetails(overlay) return (
